headline: Supervisors wanted caution. Regarding the 800 plus, banks went off the rails
summary: Banks in Poland are citing supervisory guidance to stop counting the 800 plus child benefit in loan affordability checks. money.pl reported that the supervisor did not expect this, and PKO BP has said it will resume counting the benefit.
why: Creditworthiness rules determine how much households can borrow, which affects mortgage and consumer lending. PKO BP is Poland's largest bank.
original_headline: Nadzór chciał ostrożności. Ws. 800 plus banki poszły po bandzie
